svg.title: Broward County rent burden by census tract
svg.desc: Map of 417 census tracts in Broward County, Florida. Each tract is colored by its 2020–2024 American Community Survey estimate of renter households paying 30 percent or more of household income in gross rent. Darker red indicates greater rent burden. Hover over a tract for its name and estimate.
